$comment: The neutral source of the runtime hooks: each names its event, the tools it runs on (matcher, which a SessionStart hook may leave out to run on every start), the script it runs, relative to the repository root, and its timeout in seconds. pnpm agent-harness:generate renders it for Claude Code into .claude/settings.json, and pnpm agent-harness:projection-check fails a hand edit of that file. Codex and OpenCode are not wired yet: each gets its adapter after a live test. See docs/harness.md sections 3f (the write guard) and 3g (the process reaper).
